Thanks, Tobias. I've noted that the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats. I replied in your thread in #central-team and saved the seat count to the brain under Marrow Agrisupply.

The brain warned that it has no embedding provider, so it only catches exact duplicates. If the same fact is saved again in different wording, it will show up twice. A brain owner would need to run `gbrain doctor` to change the grant that blocks some operations. Neither affects this note.
